從定量矩陣到質譜圖與統計From the quantified matrix to spectra and statistics

這一頁用廣州發現隊列已經定量好的血清 N-聚醣。分析樣本 582（HC 健康 59，CHB 慢性 B 型肝炎 101，LC 肝硬化 112，HCC 肝癌 310），聚醣 64。上一頁把 Bruker 原始檔走到峰表與組成矩陣。This page starts from the quantified Guangzhou discovery serum N-glycome. The analysis uses 582 samples (HC Healthy 59, CHB Chronic hepatitis B 101, LC Cirrhosis 112, HCC 310) and 64 glycans. The previous page goes from the Bruker raw files to the peak list and the composition matrix.

這份報告在整條流程的哪裡Where this report sits

01–03原始 fid、flexAnalysis 峰表、GlyHunter 組成。在上一頁。Raw fid, flexAnalysis peaks, GlyHunter compositions. Previous page.
04–05點位接上樣本，刪掉缺值過多的樣本，中位數商數標準化。Join spots to samples, drop sparse samples, median-quotient normalize.
06論文接著用 plate 做 ComBat。這份報告沒有裝 sva，所以直接用 log2。The paper then runs ComBat by plate. sva is not installed here, so the report uses log2 directly.
07–08log2 之後做分組檢定與分類。After log2: group tests and classification.
09本頁：質譜示意圖、PCA、火山圖、熱圖、臨床、ROC。This page: schematic spectra, PCA, volcano, heatmap, clinical plots, ROC.

下面每一段都先講這張圖在回答什麼，再給可以改的 R 片段。片段是課堂上讀的版本，完整腳本是 analysis/analyze_glycomics.R。Each section says what the figure answers, then gives an R fragment you can change. The fragments are the classroom version. The full script is analysis/analyze_glycomics.R.

檢測到的聚醣，畫成質譜示意圖Detected glycans as a schematic spectrum

橫軸不是某一個原始 fid 的掃描點，而是每個組成的理論 m/z。血清聚醣先做唾液酸甲基醯胺化，每個 NeuAc 增加 13.0316 Da，MALDI 看到的是 [M+Na]+。用這個算法，論文用來校正的五個峰會對上：H3N4F1 = 1485.534、H4N4F1 = 1647.587、H5N4S1 = 1967.709、H5N4S2 = 2271.836、H5N4F1S2 = 2417.894。The x-axis is not one raw fid scan. It is the theoretical m/z of each composition. Sialic acids were methylamidated, which adds 13.0316 Da per NeuAc, and the MALDI ion is [M+Na]+. This calculation lands on the five calibration peaks in the paper: H3N4F1 = 1485.534, H4N4F1 = 1647.587, H5N4S1 = 1967.709, H5N4S2 = 2271.836, and H5N4F1S2 = 2417.894.

高度是該組中位數商數標準化之後的中位數。最高峰設成 100，縱軸再用平方根展開，否則血清裡最高的那根峰會把其餘峰壓成一條線。四張圖比的是輪廓。紅色虛線、紅色描邊，以及峰上的結構圖，是 HCC 對 HC 達到門檻的聚醣：|log2FC| 至少 log2(1.5)，而且 BH FDR 小於 0.05。這次有 Height is the group median after median-quotient normalization. The base peak is 100, and the axis is then square-root scaled so the tallest serum peak does not flatten every other peak. The four traces compare profile shape. Red guides, red outlines, and the cartoons above the peaks are the HCC-versus-HC glycans that pass |log2 fold change| at least log2(1.5) and BH FDR below 0.05. This run has 6 個：H3N5, H7N6F1S2, H8N6F1S2, H8N5F2S3, H8N6F1S3, H8N6F1S4。 of them: H3N5, H7N6F1S2, H8N6F1S2, H8N5F2S3, H8N6F1S3, H8N6F1S4.

先分開看四個組，最下面一張是四條輪廓疊在一起。結構圖來自 glycan-structure-db。Read the four groups separately, then the bottom panel where the four profiles are merged. Cartoons come from glycan-structure-db.

m/z 怎麼從組成算出來How composition becomes m/z

part_count <- function(comp, letter) {
  hit <- regmatches(comp, regexec(paste0(letter, "([0-9]+)"), comp))[[1]]
  if (length(hit) < 2) 0 else as.integer(hit[2])
}

# Methylamidated NeuAc is 13.0316 Da heavier than native NeuAc.
# The ion is [M+Na]+, which is the residue sum plus water plus sodium.
mz_na <- function(comp) {
  part_count(comp, "H") * 162.052823 +
    part_count(comp, "N") * 203.079373 +
    part_count(comp, "F") * 146.057909 +
    part_count(comp, "S") * (291.095417 + 13.031634) +
    18.010565 + 22.989769
}

mz_na("H5N4F1S2")  # calibrant, about 2417.894

各組一條、再疊起來One trace per group, then overlay them

heights <- sapply(c("HC", "CHB", "LC", "HCC"), function(g) {
  ids <- meta$sample[meta$group == g]
  apply(norm[ids, , drop = FALSE], 2, median)
})
rel <- sweep(heights, 2, apply(heights, 2, max), "/") * 100
# Each column of rel is one group spectrum, base peak = 100.
# Draw a Gaussian at mz_na(glycan) with that height, then overlay the four columns.

PCA

每個樣本是 64 維空間裡的一個點，座標是 log2 面積。PCA 找出變異最大的方向。PC1 解釋 19.9%，PC2 解釋 15.4%。點的顏色是疾病組。若同一組的點聚在一起，代表聚醣輪廓跟疾病階段有關。Each sample is a point in a 64-dimensional space of log2 areas. PCA finds the directions of greatest variance. PC1 explains 19.9% and PC2 explains 15.4%. Color is the disease group. A group that sits together has a glycan profile related to disease stage.

pca <- prcomp(log_use, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
var_exp <- pca$sdev^2 / sum(pca$sdev^2)
plot(pca$x[, 1], pca$x[, 2], col = analysis_meta$group, pch = 19)

Biplot

箭頭是對 PC1、PC2 貢獻最大的 12 個聚醣。箭頭指向哪一群點，那個組成就在那一群比較高。Arrows are the 12 glycans with the largest loadings on PC1 and PC2. An arrow pointing toward a cloud of samples is higher in that cloud.

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2])
loadings$glycan <- rownames(loadings)
loadings$mag <- sqrt(loadings$PC1^2 + loadings$PC2^2)
top_load <- loadings[order(-loadings$mag), ][1:12, ]

火山圖：HCC 對健康對照Volcano plot: HCC versus healthy controls

橫軸是 HCC 與 HC 的 log2 中位數差，右方代表 HCC 較高。縱軸是 Wilcoxon 檢定的 -log10 p。紅色是同時通過倍數與 FDR 的 6 個聚醣，也就是質譜上畫了結構的那些峰。The x-axis is the difference of medians, HCC minus HC, on the log2 scale. Points to the right are higher in HCC. The y-axis is the Wilcoxon -log10 p value. The red points are the 6 glycans that pass both the fold-change and FDR cuts, which are the peaks drawn with structures on the spectrum.

volcano <- lapply(colnames(log_use), function(g) {
  hc <- log_use[analysis_meta$group == "HC", g]
  hcc <- log_use[analysis_meta$group == "HCC", g]
  data.frame(
    glycan = g,
    log2fc = median(hcc) - median(hc),
    p = wilcox.test(hcc, hc)$p.value
  )
})
volcano <- do.call(rbind, volcano)
volcano$fdr <- p.adjust(volcano$p, method = "BH")
volcano$sig <- volcano$fdr < 0.05 & abs(volcano$log2fc) >= log2(1.5)

分群熱圖Clustered heatmap

每個聚醣先做列方向 z-score，再依樣本與聚醣做 Ward 分群。顏色深淺是相對高低，不是原始面積。最多顯示變異最大的 50 個聚醣，否則圖會讀不出列名。Each glycan is turned into a row z-score, then samples and glycans are clustered with Ward's method. Color is relative abundance, not the raw area. At most the 50 most variable glycans are shown, so the row labels stay readable.

heat <- log_use[, order(apply(log_use, 2, var), decreasing = TRUE)]
heat <- heat[, seq_len(min(50, ncol(heat))), drop = FALSE]
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  t(scale(heat)),
  annotation_col = data.frame(group = analysis_meta$group, row.names = analysis_meta$sample),
  clustering_method = "ward.D2",
  show_colnames = FALSE
)

跟臨床數值的相關Correlation with clinical values

Spearman 相關不假設直線，只看排序。黑點是 BH FDR 小於 0.05。ALBI 用 log10(TBIL) × 0.66 − 0.085 × ALB，TBIL 用 µmol/L、ALB 用 g/L。相關最強的是 H8N5F2S3 與 ALBI（rho = 0.54，FDR = 2.49e-37）。Spearman correlation follows rank, not a straight line. Black dots are BH FDR below 0.05. ALBI is log10(TBIL) × 0.66 − 0.085 × ALB, with TBIL in µmol/L and ALB in g/L. The strongest pair is H8N5F2S3 with ALBI (rho = 0.54, FDR = 2.49e-37).

ct <- cor.test(log_use[, "H5N4F1S1"], clin$AFP, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
ct$estimate
p.adjust(p_values, method = "BH")  # do this once, across every glycan-clinical pair

箱形圖與每一個樣本Box plots with every sample

挑 Kruskal-Wallis p 最小的 6 個聚醣。箱子是四分位，點是一個血清。圖上的 p 是四組一起比較，不是兩兩比較。These are the six glycans with the smallest Kruskal-Wallis p values. The box is the quartile range and each dot is one serum. The printed p compares all four groups at once, not one pair.

library(ggpubr)
ggplot(box_df, aes(group, value, fill = group)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.16, size = 1.1, alpha = 0.65) +
  facet_wrap(~ glycan, scales = "free_y") +
  stat_compare_means(method = "kruskal.test")

機器學習與 ROCMachine learning and the ROC curve

問題是「這個人是不是 HCC」，對照組包含健康、慢性肝炎與肝硬化。先把樣本分層抽 70% 當訓練集，只在訓練集裡用 Wilcoxon 挑 10 個聚醣，再配一個邏輯斯迴歸。留下的 30% 才用來畫 ROC。聚醣模型 AUC 0.779。同一批有 AFP 的測試樣本，AFP 的 AUC 是 0.785。 選入的聚醣：H6N4F1, H6N3, H8N6F1S3, H8N5F2S3, H8N6F1S4, H7N5F1S3, H5N5F1S1, H8N6F1S2, H5N4, H7N5F1S2。The question is whether the person has HCC. The other class pools healthy, chronic hepatitis, and cirrhosis samples. A stratified 70% is the training set. Wilcoxon selection of 10 glycans happens only inside that training set, then a logistic regression is fit. The held-out 30% is what the ROC uses. The glycan model has AUC 0.779. On the test samples that have AFP, AFP alone has AUC 0.785. Selected glycans: H6N4F1, H6N3, H8N6F1S3, H8N5F2S3, H8N6F1S4, H7N5F1S3, H5N5F1S1, H8N6F1S2, H5N4, H7N5F1S2.

特徵若先用全部樣本挑好再切訓練與測試，AUC 會偏高。所以挑選放在訓練集裡面。Selecting features on all samples before the split inflates the AUC. Selection stays inside the training rows.
set.seed(42)
# Stratified 70/30 split. Feature selection stays inside the training rows.
fit <- glm(y_train ~ ., data = data.frame(y_train, x_train), family = binomial())
pred <- predict(fit, newdata = new_test, type = "response")
# Walk the score threshold and plot true-positive rate against false-positive rate.
# AUC is the area under that curve. AFP is scored the same way on the same people.
